authority.disclaimer: This harness executes bounded static and syntactic analysis using Python standard library. It makes NO claim of visual rendering proof, pixel rasterization accuracy, GPU rendering fidelity, or browser accessibility-tree computation proof.

rows.purpose: responsive logo and illustration with scalable viewBox and nested geometry
invariants: must have valid positive viewBox
must have standard preserveAspectRatio
must contain well-formed path command streams
must have zero active scripts

rows.purpose: reusable icon sprite symbol library with valid use instantiations
invariants: must declare symbols with dedicated viewBox in defs
use references must resolve to existing symbol IDs
reference graph must be strictly acyclic

rows.purpose: sprite cycle negative control with direct self-referencing use
invariants: must detect direct self-referencing cycle #sym-direct -> #sym-direct
must reject circular reference as specification error

rows.purpose: sprite cycle negative control with indirect mutual recursion
invariants: must detect transitive multi-hop cycle between symbol A and symbol B
must report recursive path

rows.purpose: linear gradient fill composed with clipPath and luminance mask
invariants: linearGradient must have valid stops and units
clipPath reference must resolve to defined clipPath ID
mask reference must resolve to defined mask with luminance mask-type

rows.purpose: geometry transform negative control with malformed parameter syntax
invariants: must catch malformed transform parameter counts and non-numeric tokens
must report exact invalid transform functions

rows.purpose: accessible meaningful diagram with title, desc, role=img, and aria-labelledby
invariants: must be classified as meaningful
must have child title matching aria-labelledby reference
must carry role=img on root element
must satisfy WCAG 2.2 Criterion 1.1.1

rows.purpose: accessible decorative background pattern with aria-hidden=true and focusable=false
invariants: must be classified as decorative
must have aria-hidden=true
must have focusable=false
must omit confusing title tags

rows.purpose: theme-adaptive icon with stroke=currentColor and fill=none
invariants: must detect currentColor on stroke or fill
must avoid hardcoded theme-incompatible colors
must be responsive with standard viewBox

rows.purpose: security negative control: active script tag injection
invariants: must detect script element
must classify as critical security violation

rows.purpose: security negative control: inline event handler attribute
invariants: must detect inline on* event handler attribute
must classify as critical security violation

rows.purpose: security negative control: foreignObject embedding active HTML script
invariants: must detect active script inside foreignObject
must flag as insecure active payload

rows.purpose: security negative control: XML external entity DOCTYPE SYSTEM declaration
invariants: must detect DOCTYPE SYSTEM entity declaration
must reject XXE vector before XML parsing

rows.purpose: SVG authored for image resource context in secure processing mode
invariants: must be strictly self-contained with no external hrefs
must have zero scripts or event handlers
must conform to secure processing mode requirements

rows.purpose: malformed XML and unclosed tags negative control
invariants: must detect XML parse syntax error
must report unclosed or mismatched tag

rows.purpose: destructive optimization negative control: stripped viewBox, stripped title, broken ID
invariants: must detect stripped viewBox when compared to original
must detect stripped title on meaningful graphic
must detect broken ID references

rows.purpose: safe optimization preserving viewBox, a11y, and references while stripping metadata
invariants: must preserve viewBox intact
must preserve title and accessibility elements
must preserve all paint and clip ID references
must successfully reduce file byte size

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): CSS styling boundary with complex external stylesheet and selector cascade
invariants: CSS cascade and external rules route to css-language-profile

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): JSX React icon component wrapper around SVG markup
invariants: JSX component syntax and React props route to jsx-language-profile

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): text typography and font rendering boundary with web font dependencies
invariants: custom font licensing and web font availability route to font-owner

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): complex multi-stage filter effects requiring visual GPU validation
invariants: filter rasterization fidelity routes to visual-validation-owner

rows.purpose: ambiguous accessibility classification: missing title, aria-hidden, or role
invariants: unlabelled SVG requires human or project determination of decorative vs meaningful

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): performance boundary: oversized single-file vector payload exceeding limits
invariants: excessive coordinate density or file size routes to performance-owner

rows.purpose: Routing scenario (fixture is context only, not an instance of the requested behavior): interactive SVG control with tabindex=0, focus visible, and keyboard access
invariants: keyboard interaction, visible focus, and accessible naming require accessibility-owner and browser verification; this fixture does not prove those behaviors
